correctness.rationale: An independent exact replay reconstructed \(\mathbb F_4\), all 16 displayed codewords, and minimum Hamming distance 3. It derived forbidden sets directly from IPP1/IPP2, finding no bad triples and 144 bad four-word subsets, then checked all \(2^{16}=65536\) subcodes. The exact optimum is 8 with 48 maximizers. Independently reconstructing all 20 affine lines of \(\operatorname{AG}(2,4)\) gives exactly 24 maxima with profile \(\{4^2,2^{16},0^2\}\) and 24 with \(\{3^8,2^4,1^8\}\). This is exhaustive finite verification, not sampling.

originality.rationale: Originality passes at the stated fixed-code level. Blackburn--Etzion--Ng give the standard IPP1/IPP2 criterion, general upper bounds, and the prolific length-four classification, including exclusion of quaternary prolific codes. Their full analysis does not determine the maximum IPP subset of this particular 16-word quaternary MDS code, enumerate all maximizers, or give the two affine-line profiles. Fresh semantic and exact-parameter searches did not surface a covering theorem.
